title: The Last Message
tagline: A missing engineer. A resignation nobody believes. A server that remembers.
intro: At 20:05, engineer Maya Levin supposedly resigned from Northstar Systems. By morning she had vanished. A colleague has asked you to investigate. You have a limited archive of documents and access to three witnesses.

characters.name: Alex Morgan
characters.opening: I left at 20:00. I didn't see Maya after that.

characters.name: Dana Cho
characters.opening: Maya thought someone was changing the audit reports. I was afraid to get involved.

characters.name: Leon Vale
characters.opening: Maya resigned. The email is plain enough. Please don't invent a conspiracy.

evidence.title: Resignation Email
evidence.content: 20:05 — From Maya: I resign effective immediately. Please do not contact me.

evidence.title: Hallway Camera Still
evidence.content: 21:40 — Two figures leave through the service stairwell. The image is too blurry for identification.

evidence.title: Maya's Desk Note
evidence.content: A scribble reads: 'Old-school rotation, thirteen steps.' Underneath: PURPX GUR ONPXHC.

evidence.title: Alex's Initial Statement
evidence.content: Alex: 'I left the building at 20:00 and never returned that night.'

evidence.title: Access Control Log
evidence.content: 22:14 — Alex Morgan's badge entered the server room.

evidence.title: Backup Manifest
evidence.content: 22:18 — Encrypted audit snapshot copied to an offline backup device.

evidence.title: Audit Diff
evidence.content: 19:52 — Audit entries were altered using Leon Vale's privileged account. Original records show fabricated customer security approvals.

evidence.title: Maya's Voice Note
evidence.content: Maya: 'I'm safe. I left by choice because Leon was erasing the proof. Alex helped copy the backup; Dana arranged somewhere safe. I never sent that resignation email.'

decrypt.name: The Rotated Message
decrypt.instruction: Decode the note's message using the clue on Maya's desk. What is the plaintext?

timeline.name: Reconstruct the Night
timeline.instruction: Put these events in chronological order, earliest first.

solution.summary: Leon altered audit data and forged the resignation. Maya went into hiding voluntarily to protect the original evidence. Alex helped retrieve a backup; Dana helped Maya stay safe.
